article.body: AI research paper published on arXiv: "State Propagation Also Satisfies: A Complex-Valued State-Space Model for Deterministic State Tracking" (2608.03425). The paper, authored by Li Xiaohe and Yang Lu, proposes the Complex State Propagator (CSP), a minimalistic recurrent architecture for deterministic state tracking tasks. The CSP only propagates hidden states across layers without output projections at intermediate steps. The state is represented as a complex-valued vector, updated via input-dependent rotations in the complex domain. The paper is available at <https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03425>.
